observation.visible_scene: An outdoor grassy clearing under a clear sky. A large open fire burns a pile of wooden planks/debris at left-center, with dark smoke rising. In the left foreground lies a light-blue quilted mattress and a rusty metal bar on the grass. The background shows a tree line, open field, and a haystack at right.
visible_changes: The flames flicker and reshape continuously throughout the segment, with smoke plumes drifting upward and leftward from the burning pile.

The foreground mattress changes orientation: it begins lying flat (top surface and rounded white piping visible horizontally) and by the later frames appears tilted/standing upright along the left edge (vertical quilted side face visible), growing taller in the frame.
The fire's position relative to the scene stays roughly constant, but its lower-left base becomes increasingly occluded by the now-upright mattress.
The background elements (tree line, horizon, right-side haystack) and the rusty bar on the ground remain at stable positions, indicating the camera is largely static rather than panning.
The mattress's change of pose is an object motion, not a camera roll, since the horizon and trees stay level.
outside_clip_unknowns: What causes the mattress to reorient from flat to upright (no operator or mechanism is visible).
Whether the burning continues or intensifies beyond the crop, and the prior state of the mattress before it stood up.
uncertain_details: Possible very slight camera shift versus pure mattress motion cannot be fully separated.
Exact identity of the burning material (wooden pallets/debris) is inferred from appearance only.
